cases.sql: CREATE SEQUENCE range_restore_seq; CREATE VIEW range_restore_ordinary AS SELECT nextval('range_restore_seq') BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AS result; CREATE VIEW range_restore_null AS SELECT nextval('range_restore_seq') BETWEEN SYMMETRIC NULL::bigint AND 100 AS result; CREATE VIEW range_restore_subquery AS SELECT (SELECT nextval('range_restore_seq')) BETWEEN SYMMETRIC 1 AND 1 AS result; CREATE VIEW range_restore_negated AS SELECT nextval('range_restore_seq') NOT BETWEEN SYMMETRIC 0 AND NULL::bigint AS result; CREATE TABLE range_restore_inputs (id integer); INSERT INTO range_restore_inputs VALUES (1),(2); CREATE VIEW range_restore_streamed AS SELECT id, nextval('range_restore_seq') BETWEEN SYMMETRIC NULL::bigint AND 100 AS result FROM range_restore_inputs
ALTER SEQUENCE range_restore_seq RESTART WITH 1; SELECT result FROM range_restore_ordinary; SELECT nextval('range_restore_seq') AS next
ALTER SEQUENCE range_restore_seq RESTART WITH 1; SELECT result FROM range_restore_null; SELECT nextval('range_restore_seq') AS next
ALTER SEQUENCE range_restore_seq RESTART WITH 1; SELECT result FROM range_restore_subquery; SELECT nextval('range_restore_seq') AS next
ALTER SEQUENCE range_restore_seq RESTART WITH 1; SELECT result FROM range_restore_negated; SELECT nextval('range_restore_seq') AS next
ALTER SEQUENCE range_restore_seq RESTART WITH 1; SELECT id,result FROM range_restore_streamed ORDER BY id; SELECT nextval('range_restore_seq') AS next
ALTER SEQUENCE range_restore_seq RESTART WITH 1; SELECT result FROM range_restore_streamed LIMIT 1; SELECT nextval('range_restore_seq') AS next

ALTER SEQUENCE range_restore_seq RESTART WITH 1; SELECT result FROM (SELECT nextval('range_restore_seq') BETWEEN SYMMETRIC NULL::bigint AND 100 AS result FROM range_restore_inputs) AS derived LIMIT 1; SELECT nextval('range_restore_seq') AS next

ALTER SEQUENCE range_restore_seq RESTART WITH 1; WITH shared AS (SELECT nextval('range_restore_seq') AS n FROM range_restore_inputs) SELECT a.n AS a,b.n AS b FROM shared a CROSS JOIN shared b ORDER BY a,b; SELECT nextval('range_restore_seq') AS next
